description: Each run in its own tmux window, named after the session, in the runner's tmux session (or in a detached "agent-tasks" session when the runner is not inside tmux). Starts an interactive shell and types the agent command into it, so shell aliases work; the shell exits with the agent. The handle is the server's socket and the agent's pane, so later commands reach the right server even without $TMUX. tmux knows nothing about agents: status is working while the pane lives and gone once it closed (exited only for a dead pane kept by remain-on-exit), so blocked runs are not detected. Needs tmux 3.0 or later.
launch: name=$1 cwd=$2; shift 2; fmt='#{socket_path} #{pane_id}'; if [ -n "$TMUX" ]; then sid=$(tmux display-message -p ${TMUX_PANE:+-t "$TMUX_PANE"} '#{session_id}') && [ -n "$sid" ] || exit 1; exec tmux new-window -d -P -F "$fmt" -t "$sid:" -n "$name" -c "$cwd" -- "$@"; fi; if ! tmux has-session -t '=agent-tasks' 2>/dev/null; then tmux new-session -d -P -F "$fmt" -s agent-tasks -n "$name" -c "$cwd" -- "$@" && exit; fi; exec tmux new-window -d -P -F "$fmt" -t '=agent-tasks:' -n "$name" -c "$cwd" -- "$@"
then: s=${1% %*} p=%${1##* %}; tmux -S "$s" send-keys -t "$p" -l "$2" && tmux -S "$s" send-keys -t "$p" Enter
status: s=${1% %*} p=%${1##* %}; out=$(tmux -S "$s" display-message -p -t "$p" '#{pane_id} #{pane_dead}') || exit 1; [ "${out%% *}" = "$p" ] || exit 1; echo "${out#* }"
attach: s=${1% %*} p=%${1##* %}; tmux -S "$s" select-window -t "$p" || exit; if [ -n "$TMUX" ]; then exec tmux -S "$s" switch-client -t "$p"; else exec tmux -S "$s" attach-session -t "$p"; fi
